name: barbell reverse band bench press
description: A bench press with bands that lighten the load at the bottom and add heavier tension near the top. It builds pressing strength.
instructions: Set up on a bench with bands anchored to the rack and attached to the bar.
Lie back with your eyes under the bar and your shoulder blades pinched.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Press the bar back up to straight arms, feeling the band resistance change.
Keep your feet planted and your wrists stacked over your elbows.
